mapper.select: SELECT e.event_key, e.category_cd, COALESCE(c.code_name, e.category_cd) AS category_name, e.title, e.description, e.start_dtm, e.end_dtm, e.all_day_yn, e.location_nm, e.color_cd FROM cal_event e LEFT JOIN com_code c ON c.code = e.category_cd WHERE e.use_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY e.start_dtm, e.end_dtm
SELECT code, code_name, COALESCE(extra1, 'indigo') AS color FROM com_code WHERE parent_code = '401' AND use_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY sort_order, code
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cal_event ( category_cd, title, description, start_dtm, end_dtm, all_day_yn, location_nm, color_cd, use_yn, reg_user, reg_dtm, reg_ip, upd_user, upd_dtm, upd_ip ) VALUES ( #{categoryCd}, #{title}, #{description}, #{startDtm}, #{endDtm}, #{allDayYn}, #{locationNm}, #{colorCd}, 'Y', #{updatedBy}, NOW(), CAST(#{updatedIp} AS INET), #{updatedBy}, NOW(), CAST(#{updatedIp} AS INET) )
mapper.update: UPDATE cal_event SET category_cd = #{categoryCd}, title = #{title}, description = #{description}, start_dtm = #{startDtm}, end_dtm = #{endDtm}, all_day_yn = #{allDayYn}, location_nm = #{locationNm}, color_cd = #{colorCd}, upd_user = #{updatedBy}, upd_dtm = NOW(), upd_ip = CAST(#{updatedIp} AS INET) WHERE event_key = #{eventKey} AND use_yn = 'Y'
UPDATE cal_event SET use_yn = 'N', upd_user = 'system', upd_dtm = NOW() WHERE event_key = #{eventKey} AND use_yn = 'Y'
